hypothesis: The frozen Stage1 policy caps effective beta at a constant action_beta=0.6. A constant cap cannot be right in both calm and volatile regimes. Test a pre-registered family of volatility-scaled dynamic caps that use only past realized SOXX volatility, on the frozen upstream raw target, and require the improvement to hold on the out-of-sample window and not be concentrated in a single year.
cap_rule: cap_t = clip(scale * rolling_median_vol / realized_vol_t, 0.3, 1.5); realized vol is trailing, causal
causality_rule: Only past realized volatility sets the cap; the raw upstream target is unchanged; returns are the frozen recording's realized open-to-open returns.

gates.improvement: selected rule must beat the constant baseline on development Sharpe AND on the outer Sharpe

stopping: Exactly the pre-registered rule family at two costs; no tuning after outcomes. Preserve all results, including failures.
limitations: Re-projects a frozen signal; no new data or model.
The source signal was itself fixed in-sample; this is not independent forward evidence.
Annual stability is reported so a pooled gain from one regime is visible.
